title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Jungbaaz Khiladi
desc: Youngsters Shiva and Vicky earn a living making videos on a digital platform and prank Jeepakaran, a businessman. However, Jeepakaran asks them to work for him in return for money.

title: Shivam
desc: Shiva, the ever-helpful friend, finds himself smitten with Tanu, sparking a love story that stirs up trouble with Bhoji Reddy.

title: Valimai
desc: When a city's crime rate rises, it is up to Arjun, a police officer, to restore order.

title: The Kerala Story
desc: Shalini, a former nursing student from Kerala, who later becomes the wife of a terrorist, testifies her life story and her journey from being a naive girl to another victim of terrorism.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.
